t: The Great Stuffing: Forging an AI-Native Magic Wand in Python
s: This article details the refactoring of a Python function into a self-contained, AI-collaborative object, challenging traditional dependency injection patterns and aiming for a more intuitive, externalized thinking process augmented by AI.
sub: Architectural discovery and externalized thinking with AI
Critique of Python dependency injection jargon and 'programming priesthood'
Building an AI-native, self-contained Python object ('magic wand')
Using AI as an intellectual partner for conceptual tightening
